title: Bonn intracranial EEG segments, sets C, D and E (Andrzejak et al. 2001)
description: This dataset contains 300 single-channel intracranial EEG segments (23.6 s each, 173.61 Hz) from five epilepsy patients, drawn from the Bonn EEG data of Andrzejak et al. (2001). It includes sets C and D (seizure-free interictal recordings from the hippocampal formation of the opposite hemisphere and from the epileptogenic zone) and set E (ictal activity). The data are a lossless BIDS re-packaging of the original text files. Scalp EEG sets A and B are excluded, and segments are pooled under one pseudo-subject because the source does not map them to patients.
methods_description: Segments were cut from continuous multichannel clinical recordings from the presurgical-diagnosis archive, after visual artifact inspection and a weak-stationarity check. Recordings used depth electrodes in the hippocampal formations and strip electrodes on the neocortex. All signals were acquired with a 128-channel amplifier using an average common reference, 12-bit digitization at 173.61 Hz, and 0.53-40 Hz band-pass filtering. The source text files were converted to BrainVision format without filtering, resampling or rescaling.
